title: White dwarfs 2026: measurements
description: Measurements of white dwarfs from public SDSS-V DR20 spectra (Astra 0.8.1 visit spectra and BOSS per-exposure spectra), with DESI DR1, SDSS/BOSS, ESO X-shooter, TESS, HST/COS, GALEX, ATLAS, ZTF and Gaia DR3 epoch photometry. Topics: Ca II triplet emission from gaseous discs; carbon lines; Zeeman splitting; photometric periods; TESS amplitude spectra of pulsation candidates; an eclipse and Balmer emission; hot white dwarfs with He II lines; short-period white dwarfs with irradiated companions; day-scale periods of hot white dwarfs; periods of DA white dwarfs with emission lines; hydrogen and helium line strengths that change between visits; magnetic field strength changing between visits; radial-velocity variable DA white dwarfs (double white dwarf candidates). Each topic has a page, measurement tables (CSV), figures and per-object pages, and the scripts download the public data and recompute the per-object tables and figures. Existing SIMBAD, MWDD and SDSS-V SnowWhite classifications are given with the measurements.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. Tables and figures: CC BY 4.0; code: MIT.
